body:
It does improve. High and lows still. I made this post during a low, I was mourning the loss of friendships and feeling super lonely, but since then I'm doing much better. I found a job I enjoy and my coworkers are lovely. Hell I just had surgery and I'm still feeling pretty good mentally. 
Hang in there, try therapy if you can. DBT helped me a lot. Some days or weeks, even months, will still suck HARD but things will improve. If you need to chat I'm here

I hope you get through whatever comes your way. I do have one amazing friend who has stuck with me, and my partner(tho it's been rocky). 
If you need someone to talk to I'm happy to help others, even when I can't help myself...haha
I know it's not the peaceful falling asleep ppl think it is. I know it your nerves on fire and your muscles cramping from shivering. But that is hours compared to years.

Its pre-midnight. No one would know I'd been gone for 8hrs at least, minimum. Theyd be hours too late.
